analysis_status: Post-selection exploratory analysis fixed before the full bootstrap run
scope: All seven internal DEVELOPMENT_OUTER domains and all 42 directed external domains; five fresh matched arms only
sampling: Unstratified multinomial bootstrap of the original unique dependency groups; draw the original number of groups with replacement. All units in a sampled group receive its multiplicity, including mixed-label groups.
paired_draws: One ordered 2000-draw multiplicity matrix per original cohort, reused unchanged for all models, training seeds, source folds and source datasets evaluated on that cohort
valid_draw_family: Require positive weighted counts of both classes in the entire cohort and each of its original three OUTER folds. Reject an invalid cohort draw for every model/source together and count rejections; stop after 2000 common valid draws. Do not drop a model-specific undefined replicate.
estimand: Calculate every trained fit's metric separately. Average the three fixed source-fold values within each training seed, then equally average the five training seed means. Internal resampling restricts the same cohort multiplicities to each original OUTER fold. External resampling uses the complete target cohort for every trained fit.
training_variability: The models, training seeds, source folds and saved source INNER thresholds are fixed. No training-seed or fold resampling. Report the SD across the five original seed means separately from the conditional population interval.
fixed_threshold: Use each fit's saved source_INNER_F1 threshold unchanged for fixed-threshold metrics and FP/FN. No bootstrap threshold recalibration.
retrospective_95: Recompute attainable tied-score ROC operating points in each weighted sample, with the original exact integer inequalities 20*FP<=N and 20*FN<=P; include the all-negative positive-infinity point. These are retrospective target-label metrics, not transported clinical thresholds.
interval: Paired LINEAR_REF-minus-control differences; percentile 95% intervals using NumPy quantile(method='linear') at 0.025 and 0.975, without selecting favourable domains
calibration: Brier and ECE are calculated per trained fit and then use the same three-fold/five-seed averaging. Reliability uses ten fixed probability bins [0,0.1,...,1]; bins are left-closed/right-open except the final bin includes 1. Empty bins are unavailable, not zero-filled; report contributing-run counts for nonempty-run descriptive means.
checkpoints: Hash-bound cohort draws and per-domain resumable bootstrap checkpoints; final completion requires all 49 domains
limitations: Intervals condition on the fitted and selected models and observed cohorts; they do not account for adaptive method selection, source training population uncertainty, shared subjects of unknown linkage across cohorts, or uncertainty for a new institution. The 42 transfers are not independent validation cohorts.
